_about: Template. Copy this file to <subdomain>.<zone>.json (for example mc.is-a.ceo.json), fill it in, and open a pull request. Omit the keys you do not need; omitting "records" entirely gives the GitHub Pages default. This example uses a CNAME because that is the common case for Netlify, Vercel and GitHub Pages user sites. Use A and AAAA instead when you have your own IPs: a CNAME cannot coexist with A, AAAA, MX, NS, SRV or PTR on the same name. The subdomain may be "@" (zone apex), a wildcard (*.app, only if you already claim app), or dotted labels such as _acme-challenge.app. A/AAAA must be public IPs, and CNAME/MX/NS/SRV/PTR targets must be public hostnames. "proxied" defaults to false and should stay that way for GitHub Pages. Every record shape is documented in SCHEMA.json.
description: Subdomain for Irfan Hariyanto's personal projects and portfolio.
